messages:
tara: opened PR to align docs voice + terminology across the SDK pages. small changes: prefer 'Redwood' over 'we' in product descriptions, use active voice in how-tos, and unify 'model variant' vs 'model family' to 'model variant'. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :eyes:

miguel: thanks! will review today. tagging sasha for tone check. do we want to enforce via a lint rule or keep as reviewer guidance? :thinking_face:

sasha: +1 on automated checks where possible. we can add a docs-lint rule that flags 'we' in product pages, but examples and tutorials should stay conversational. maybe have a whitelist for 'we' in tutorials.

luca: quick heads-up — CI/docs preview found a broken link on the migration guide (section 'Dedicated -> Private'). failing link-checker: 1 broken link. preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/482

tara: thanks luca. broken link is the sample config reference. i'll push a fix in a follow-up commit in this PR. do we want to wait for a full pass before merging?

alex: for timing — if fixes are small (link + tone nits) we can merge after 1 approving review and green CI. if we need structural edits, hold for 2 approvals. recommendation: fix link, run preview, then merge by EOD if green. :thumbsup:

miguel: reviewed top-level sections. left inline comments about consistency in headings (use sentence case) and about using backticks for parameter names. also flagged a place where the Python SDK snippet uses posargs instead of keyword args — small code edit.

sasha: replying to the tone policy — examples should be friendly but unambiguous. prefer 'Use this call to' over 'You can use this call to' in reference docs. for tutorials keep 'we' and 'let's'. added comments in the PR with examples.

tara: pushed fixes: link + SDK snippet updated to `client.generate(prompt="...")` and heading cases normalized. also added a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about tone buckets (reference vs tutorial).

docs-ci: preview build complete — all checks passed except for one docstyle warning: 'avoid passive voice' flagged in migration-guide.md: line 214. See preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/482#migration-guide

miguel: where is the passive voice flagged? can you paste the sentence?

docs-ci: "Migration was completed by the operator in minute 3" flagged. suggestion: "The operator completed the migration at minute 3."

tara: fixed that sentence and squashed commits. requesting reviews: @miguel + @alex again for sign-off.

alex: re-reviewing now. small nit: terminology section should include 'fallback policy' definition — add one sentence. otherwise LGTM.

miguel: looks good to me. approving. :white_check_mark:

alex: approved. merging after preview stability check (2 minutes).

luca: preview stable. merging window open.

tara: merged and deployed to production docs. thanks all! i'll follow up tomorrow with a short changelog entry and a note in the docs-maintainers channel about the new tone buckets. :tada:
